raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: pyepics
  version: "3.5.10"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/pyepics-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: f390cf9be40aba757b9528888114bc14d8db01086d0c93914720b1772460375b
  patches:
    - package_data.patch

build:
  number: 1

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: python
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then: cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
  host:
    - python
    - setuptools >=45
    - setuptools-scm >=6.2
    - pip
  run:
    - python
    # pkg_resources used in epics/ca.py
    - setuptools
    - epics-base
    - numpy >=1.26
    - pyparsing
    - importlib_resources

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - epics
        - epics.autosave
        - epics.compat
        - epics.devices
      pip_check: true
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
    script:
      - python -c "import epics; epics.ca.find_libca()"

about:
  license: EPICS
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Python interface to Epics Channel Access
  homepage: https://pyepics.github.io/pyepics/
  repository: https://github.com/pyepics/pyepics
  documentation: https://pyepics.github.io/pyepics

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
    - hhslepicka
    - mrakitin
    - stuartcampbell
    - tacaswell
